texts.facts: This writ petition is filed seeking quashing the notice dated 22.12.2012 issued by the fifth respondent at Annexure-D and for mandamus to consider the application filed to the second respondent. 2. The case of the petitioner is that he has obtained permission from the fourth respondent to carry on the industry of manufacturer of packaged drinking water in the name and style as Balaji Products. He has invested huge amount, engaged the employees and purchased the vehicles to transport. He has got tested the water from the concerned authorities. The fifth respondent issued notice dated 22.12.2012, to the petitioner asking him to produce the ISI certificate or applied acknowledgment. He has applied for ISI (BSI) certificate on 11.01.2013 by submitting relevant documents and paying requisite fee. The said request is yet to be considered. In the meanwhile on 23.1.2013 the first respondent issued one more notice asking him to close the business, otherwise they have threaten to disconnect the electricity supply. Therefore petitioner approached before this Court. In similar matter in the batch of cases in W.P.No.100504-100508/2013 & W.P.No.100516/ 2013, the following observations are made in para 3. It reads as under; "3. The question which is involved in this writ petition was the subject matter of batch of writ petitions before the Principal Bench in W.P.No.17713/2012 and other connected matters. 2. W.P.Nos.17467-17498/2012 and W.P.Nos. 24257-283/2012 are hereby disposed of.
texts.arguments: 5.
